report_name: Global Secret Group Ransomware Targets Texas Mental Health Practice

threat_actors.name: Global Secret Group
threat_actors.description: A ransomware operator that claimed responsibility for an attack on Vernon & Waldrep, a Texas-based mental health practice. The group listed the victim on its data leak site, alleging the exfiltration of 274 GB of sensitive data.
threat_actors.goals: Financial extortion through data theft and ransomware deployment.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
attack_patterns.description: The Global Secret Group claimed to have exfiltrated 274 GB of data, comprising over 56,000 files, from the victim's network before encryption.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: As a ransomware operator, Global Secret Group's attack playbook includes encrypting local systems to disrupt the victim's operations and compel a ransom payment.

malware.name: Global Secret Group Ransomware
malware.description: The ransomware used by the 'Global Secret Group' in their claimed attack against Vernon & Waldrep. The attack involved data exfiltration and likely system encryption.

identities.name: Vernon & Waldrep
identities.description: A small mental health practice based in Texas that was listed as a victim on the Global Secret Group's data leak site. The attackers claimed to have stolen 274 GB of sensitive patient data.

infrastructure.name: Global Secret Group Data Leak Site
infrastructure.description: A data leak site used by the Global Secret Group to list victims and publicize stolen data. Vernon & Waldrep was added to this site on August 1, 2026.

indicators.name: PowerShell Archiving of Sensitive Data Folders
indicators.pattern:
title: PowerShell Archiving of Sensitive Data Folders
id: 2b9c1d8e-4f5a-4b6c-8d9e-0f1a2b3c4d5e
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of PowerShell to recursively archive directories with names commonly associated with patient records, a potential precursor to data exfiltration.
references:
  - https://www.galaxywarden.com/blog/breach/vernon-waldrep-global-secret-group-2026-08
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-02
tags:
  - attack.t1560.001
  - attack.collection
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '\powershell.exe'
  selection_cmdline:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'Get-ChildItem'
      - 'Compress-Archive'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'Patients'
      - 'EHR'
      - 'PHI'
      - 'Records'
  condition: all of selection_*
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate administrative scripts for backing up patient data.
indicators.description: Detects the use of PowerShell to recursively archive directories with names commonly associated with patient records, a potential precursor to data exfiltration, as suggested in the report's hunting hints.

relationships.target_name: Global Secret Group Data Leak Site

relationships.source_name: PowerShell Archiving of Sensitive Data Folders
